description: This file defines a class for local end-of-turn detection using an ONNX model in an on-device ML inference context. It includes model loading, feature extraction, and prediction methods for the smart-turn-v3 model, specifically for offline operation without network dependency.

classes.name: LocalSmartTurnAnalyzerV3
classes.description: A class for analyzing smart turns locally using an ONNX model, enabling offline end-of-turn detection.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the analyzer, loads the ONNX model, and sets up inference session and feature extractor.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Predicts end-of-turn based on input audio array by processing audio, extracting features, and running ONNX inference.
